def factor_volume_beta_range_asymmetry_gated(df):
    """Volume-confirmed return beta gated by range asymmetry correlation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy['volume'].clip(lower=1e-12))
    dlog_volume = log_volume.diff()
    cov = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).cov(dlog_volume)
    var_vol = dlog_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).var(ddof=1)
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    range_ = df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low']
    range_chg = range_.pct_change()
    range_chg = range_chg.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    corr_range = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(range_chg)
    weight = 1.0 + 0.5 * corr_range
    factor = beta * weight
    df_copy['factor_volume_beta_range_asymmetry_gated'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_volume_beta_range_asymmetry_gated']
description: Preserves the qualified parent's core mechanism: rolling sensitivity of daily returns to volume changes, capturing volume-confirmed accumulation or distribution. Borrows from the secondary parent the idea of range-based volatility asymmetry. Instead of a separate signal, it uses the rolling correlation between returns and high-low range changes as a continuous, bounded reliability weight (0.5 to 1.5). When returns and range changes are positively correlated, volume-confirmed moves are reinforced; when negatively correlated (leverage effect), the beta is dampened. This keeps the raw single-stock signal continuous and interpretable, targeting improved MI and robustness while preserving RankICIR and volume-confirmed beta lineage.
